note: v1 92.69 (seeds 0/11 92.69/92.70), When the Tape Runs Out, the closer: chillwave dusk at 78 bpm. A soft electro-kit (12-bit crushed) and a juno pad that breathes against the kick (sidechain duck) and warbles on wM's tape deck, under a dreamy wordless vox line (dream-vox), a slow arpeggio with a dotted-eighth tape echo, a pulsing analog bass and crackle; Dmaj9 Bm11 Gmaj7#11 A6sus. THE RUN-OUT is the form: after the full band every section loses a voice (kick, then arp, then bass) until the vox and pad are alone, and the tape stops over the last bar. Draft 88.5 -> 92.7: a dotted clave and the arp's 3/16 echo for off-grid motion, low end and loudness for the lo-fi master range.
